fixture: Independent generated survival world. Ordinary double-space flight entry and W movement use client KeyMapping input and production controller; flight is never pre-enabled for these paths. Two explicit zero-speed ClientboundPlayerAbilitiesPacket injections plus cleared state/client realm2 model the reported fallback failure. Injection clears previous momentum to test new W movement; second injection records an actual server tick outside the 40-tick sync boundary.
inputScope: Logical KeyMapping press/release states on the isolated client; no native physical keyboard events or GLFW modifier-state certification. Left Shift sprint and left Control crouch are remapped and both hold/toggle settings are exercised.
movementScope: Actual client/server position changes and flight flags, not renderer submission counters. Server snapshots run on the integrated-server thread and can trail client samples by a tick.
waterScope: After the original checks, restore a realm8 idle-flying save condition with no controller state, zero speed/motion and feet135.5575 partly submerged in source water at y135 with air above. W + one continuous jump hold at ticks680..710 tests observed horizontal/up movement; initial water contact is required, later exit from water is allowed and recorded.
